findings.message: Account `rebirth_record` uses `init_if_needed`; review for re-initialization or state-reset risk.
findings.help: Prefer #[account(init, ...)] when possible. If init_if_needed is necessary, confirm the account cannot be abused to reset state.

findings.message: Function `cancel_limit_order` writes to an account after a CPI call to `token::transfer` without reloading; account data may be stale.
findings.help: Call account.reload()? after the CPI to refresh account data before reading or writing.

findings.message: Function `set_fees` writes to account state but has no emit!() or msg!(); off-chain observers cannot track this state change.
findings.help: Add emit!(MyEvent { ... }) or a structured msg!("...") after state changes so indexers and dashboards can observe transitions.

findings.message: `assets` used as divisor in `/` without a zero-check; if zero at runtime the transaction will panic
findings.help: Use checked_div() or checked_rem() and handle the None case, or add require!(divisor != 0, ...) before the operation.

findings.message: `(total as u128)` used as divisor in `/` without a zero-check; if zero at runtime the transaction will panic
findings.help: Use checked_div() or checked_rem() and handle the None case, or add require!(divisor != 0, ...) before the operation.

findings.message: Account `authority` appears to be an authority but has no signer constraint and no is_signer guard; an attacker can pass an unsigned account.
findings.help: Use Signer<'info> as the field type, add #[account(signer)], or add require!(account.is_signer, ...) in the instruction handler.
